item.title: Jay Bradley - "We did well to come back from being 3-0 down" - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: Inishowen were 3-0 down at half-time in this afternoon’s Oscar Traynor first-leg meeting with old foes Donegal at Ballyare. Jay Bradley, a goal-scorer for Inishowen, spoke to Chris Ashmore after the game and said the team showed bravery to come back into the tie.

item.title: New Donegal Vet School to be formally launched this afternoon - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: Donegal ATU will formally launch its new veterinary programme this afternoon. Further and Higher Education Minister James Lawless is due to visit the college for the event. The programme has been developed in a bid to tackle the shortage of veterinary professionals, particularly in rural communities.

item.description: Seven Donegal projects have been allocated funding totalling over €97,000 under the Local Biodiversity Action Fund 2026.
